description: Root entry files must expose a `tree` subcommand listing every available command and option
check: for f in $(find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*.py' -type f); do if grep -q '__name__ == "__main__"' "$f"; then python "$f" tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "FAIL: $f"; fi; done
fix: Add a `tree` subcommand to the entry file. See mc.py:822 (Click group) or services.py:cmd_tree (argparse) for templates. The tree must list every subcommand and its flags so context-gathering prompts can discover the CLI surface programmatically.
